dev: RemoteDesktop: Enable ARC++ and keep state * Fix GAIALogin() with KeepState(). * Use KeepState() would make the test about 2x faster for existing user. The improvement is 38s => 20s on my Eve. * Enable ARC++ with Play Store and without manual opt-in every time, thanks to KeepState(). Note that it will keep ARC++ disabled if the user opt-out, which is the desired behavior. User might want to disable ARC++ to reduce the log spam and make it boot faster. BUG=b:134038021 TEST=tast run with ARC++ enabled/disabled. Change-Id: I30568c5fafd5228f15ded997afffeddb59c887af Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1769959 Tested-by: Shik Chen <shik@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Shik Chen <shik@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ricardo Quesada <ricardoq@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org>
